name: VibeWave v2.4.7 - YouTube Listening History & Mega Update
body:
### 🚀 VibeWave v2.4.7 Update!

- 📜 **YouTube-Style Listening History:** Gaana sunte hi automatic history banna, Settings aur Library se direct browse & play karein!
- 🔊 **Volume Booster (+200%):** Speaker aur headphone me 200% tak sound boost karein!
- 🚗 **Car Driving Mode:** Gaadi chalate waqt safe full-screen big buttons UI!
- 🎛️ **Desi Equalizer Presets:** Desi Dholak & Bass, Ghazal Clarity, Bhakti, Party EDM presets!
- ⚡ **Direct Fast Auto-Updates:** Bina kisi rukawat ke direct app ke andar updates!
